message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes in the history of the sport. He was born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, and rose to prominence as a high school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School. LeBron was selected first overall in the 2003 NBA Draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers and has since played for the Miami Heat, Cleveland Cavaliers (again), and the Los Angeles Lakers.

He is known for his exceptional combination of size, athleticism, court vision, and basketball IQ. Over his career, LeBron has earned numerous accolades, including multiple NBA championships, MVP awards, All‑Star selections, and Olympic gold medals with Team USA. His impact extends beyond the court; he is also a philanthropist, entrepreneur, and media personality, founding the LeBron James Family Foundation and producing various television projects.
